$comment: Shard definitions for the Stryker matrix in .github/workflows/test-quality.yml. Read by that workflow (`node -p`), never by Stryker itself, so it stays out of stryker.config.json (which warns on unknown keys). Shards are split until no shard is expected to exceed ~10 minutes: big single-file shards are bounded by mutant count, multi-file shards also pay per-file test-runner setup. Note run-to-run variance is large (two identical 447-mutant/4-file shards measured 4:52 and 9:42), so treat these as a good split, not a precise one. Regenerate if src/lib changes materially.
